We are looking for a knowledgeable and customer‑focused Cooling / Air‑Conditioning Technician or Engineer to provide remote (telephone‑based) technical support for computer room and data center cooling applications.
In this role, you will act as a key technical reference for our customers, leveraging your solid experience in the cooling industry — particularly with DX and chilled‑water systems — to support both pre‑sales and post‑sales activities. You will contribute to delivering reliable, high‑quality solutions while ensuring a positive and professional customer experience throughout the full engagement lifecycle.
 What will you do:
Provide technical support and guidance to customers via telephone and email
Assist customers with product selection, system design, and troubleshooting
Attend appropriate quality conference calls
Collaborate with the sales team to provide technical expertise during the pre-sales process
Conduct post-sales support by addressing customer inquiries and resolving technical issues
Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and product developments
Contribute to the development of technical support documentation and resources.
 What Qualifications Will Make You Successful
 Languages
Fluent French(spoken and written) is required
Good working proficiency in English.
 Technical Expertise
Proven experience in the cooling / air‑conditioning industry, with hands‑on exposure to DX and chilled water systems
Understanding of computer room and data center cooling requirements is a strong advantage
Solid PC skills, with proficiency in relevant software applications and digital tools.
 Professional Skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and internal teams
Strong problem‑solving and analytical capabilities, with a structured approach to troubleshooting technical challenges
Ability to perform well in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities with confidence.
 Education & Certifications
Completed a recognized apprenticeship as a Refrigeration / Air Conditioning Technician, or
Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.
Relevant HVAC or cooling‑related certifications are considered an advantage.
 What's in it for me?
Flexible work schedule and home-office options (hybrid)
A wide range of benefits: Bookster, Flexible Benefits by Edenred, Meal tickets, discounts at several partners
Medical & healthcare options: Private medical subscription; Life insurance
Mental healthcare: Employee Assistance Program (24/7 online counseling)
One day off to celebrate your birthday with your beloved ones
Hands-on training and access to our technical labs
Development Plan through Career path and coaching
Schneider Career HUB- a platform where you can easily find your next challenge, an exciting project, coffee chats or a cool mentor
Sustainability is at the heart of what we do, who we are, and what we believe in
Exposure to a multicultural and dynamic environment.
